verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents a `crewai test` CLI command that runs a crew for multiple iterations and reports performance metrics. The AMP Visual Agent and Task Builders also offer "real-time testing," which gives some pre-deployment testing workflow. None of this evidence describes an isolated sandbox environment or any guarantee that tests avoid production data or side-effecting tools. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/staging environment, separation of test and production data, mock or dry-run tool execution, and independent corroboration.
